note: First-pass audit of the 60 dev trial questions by Claude agents reading each question's candidate pack (top-10 retrieved chunks, remaining same-page chunks, held-out pages) and grepping the corpus; not the manual audit the proposal requires. verdict: valid | leaked (a remaining chunk states the asked information) | partial (a related page covers part of it) | invalid | unclear; in_top_k: whether the cited chunk is in the top 5 (B/C) or a gold chunk is (A).
